description: Keep a note beside the work it belongs to, one keystroke from any thread. Notes group themselves by project, thread and day, so nothing lands in a flat pile. Stickies pin to a thread or a project and appear only while you are looking at it, and every thread gets a scratchpad your agents can append findings to. Writes real markdown — clickable checklists, highlighted code fences, wiki links — and stores everything in a local SQLite file with no account and no network.
